description: Annotate a person for your organization: replace their tags, set notes, mute/unmute them, or set the outreach owner (ownerId, a member user id; null clears) and stage. Muting hides their posts from the feed and from every channel; ingest and billing are unchanged. With groupId the annotations are that keyword group's own: muted hides the person from the mentions of that group's keywords only (feed, alerts and digests), and the group's tags show on those mentions next to the workspace's. A mute set without groupId hides them for every group.

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

muted.description: true hides their posts from the feed, the alerts and the digests; false shows them again. Without groupId, for every keyword of the workspace; with groupId, for the mentions of that group's keywords only, leaving the workspace's mute as it is.

ownerId.description: The member who owns the contact (user id); null clears.

stage.description: Where your workspace stands with the person: not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer or not_a_fit.

name: update_person
title: Update person
